subject: Stream + Toolcall Songbook — run-of-show and JSON contract
messages:
From: Alex Dunn <adunn@carebridge.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: product@carebridge.com
Date: 2028-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Implementation request — need a 'songbook' for live streaming + toolcalls

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the streaming and function-calling examples map well to how we'll triage live chats in our support flows. Legal and Engineering asked for a compact "songbook" that lays out the run-of-show for implementation: sequence of events, JSON contracts we should implement for structured outputs, validation gates, and an expected timeline to go from sandbox -> pilot -> production.

High level asks from our side:
- Clear schema for the streaming payload (prefix caching expectations, session IDs).
- Example toolcall contracts and failure/fallback semantics.
- Minimal acceptance criteria we can sign off on (latency, token caps, schema validation pass).
- A suggested 3-week pilot cadence and a short checklist for CS handoff to Eng/Prod.

Can you send a compact doc or spreadsheet that we can share with our SRE and product leads before the kickoff? Also propose 30–45m for a kickoff run-of-show — we have availability Aug 24–25.

I'll loop in our security lead after we see the songbook.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Dunn
Head of Integrations | CareBridge Health
adunn@carebridge.com

Attachment: carebridge_initial_cadence.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Alex Dunn <adunn@carebridge.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation request — need a 'songbook' for live streaming + toolcalls

Hi Alex — great to hear this is lining up with your flows. I've attached a compact "songbook" spreadsheet and a draft JSON contract for the streaming payload (streaming-json-contract-v1.json). The internals of the songbook are intentionally prescriptive so your SRE and product teams can follow a reproducible run-of-show.

High-level run-of-show (proposed):
1) Sandbox handoff (days 0–3): provide test keys, sample traffic generator, and our schema (attached).
2) Integration window (days 4–10): implement streaming client, validate prefix/KV behavior against our sample prompts.
3) Pilot (days 11–21): 1–2 data customers, acceptance criteria checks — schema validation >= 99%, 95th pct latency within agreed SLO, toolcall success/fallback exercised.
4) CS->Prod checklist (day 21): final signing template, rollback plan, monitoring hooks (tracing + per-session token cost).

Key files attached: streaming-json-contract-v1.json (schema + example messages), and a one-sheet "songbook" cadence (20280822-carebridge-proposed-songbook.xlsx). We also included an explicit example of a toolcall failure path and recommended fallback to a lighter model variant.

Proposed kickoff: Aug 24, 10:00 AM PT — 45 min. We'll bring product, engineering enablement (Soojin), and CS (Marissa). Please confirm and I'll share a short agenda + Drive link.

Also: who should we loop in on security/compliance (data retention query + audit log access)? If you want, share an SRE contact and we'll include Soojin for pre-kickoff scoping.

—
Jasmine Liu
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Redwood Inference — Runtime & Ops

Attachments: 20280822-carebridge-proposed-songbook.xlsx, streaming-json-contract-v1.json

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-23T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: prep notes for CareBridge kickoff (Aug 24) — run-of-show + handoff items

Soojin / Marissa — quick internal note ahead of tomorrow's kickoff. Copy of the songbook and schema are attached in the thread. Key things for us to own:
- Validation harness: Soojin, can you bring the small script (schema-checker + synthetic stream generator) so we can demo schema gating?
- Toolcall contract: Marissa, confirm the recommended retry/fallback semantics (we suggest 2 retries then model-variant fallback + alert).
- Monitoring: we'll request per-session traces and a token-cost dashboard; make sure we have a stubbed plan to show how to surface 95th pct latency by route.
- Security ask: Alex will bring a retention question — we should prepare recommended defaults (30/90/365) and explain how audit logs are surfaced in Private vs Dedicated.

Agenda for kickoff (45m):
1) 5m intros / scope
2) 10m run-of-show walkthrough (songbook)
3) 15m schema & toolcall contract deep-dive (Soojin walk-through)
4) 10m acceptance criteria & rollout cadence
5) 5m next steps / owners

I'll send the calendar invite once Alex confirms.

Thanks,
Jasmine

From: Alex Dunn <adunn@carebridge.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: product@carebridge.com
Date: 2028-08-24T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation request — need a 'songbook' for live streaming + toolcalls

Jasmine — thanks, this looks great. Confirming Aug 24, 10:00 AM PT works for us. I'll join along with our lead SRE (Lina Park) and our security manager (security@carebridge.com).

Two quick asks before the call:
- Can you include a one-line summary in the Drive link that spells out the minimal data retention options and where logs live for Dedicated vs Hosted? Our security manager wants to avoid a long pre-call doc dump.
- Please add a short example of a toolcall POST payload in streaming-json-contract-v1.json showing failure headers and the expected 'fallback' model id.

I'll add the Drive link to the calendar invite and share Lina's contact. Looking forward — Alex

Alex Dunn
Head of Integrations | CareBridge Health
adunn@carebridge.com
